summary: Nora can hear video and audio now: a clip's sound reaches the describer, and speech in it is transcribed.
details: Video is read with its audio track instead of silently stripped, so what people say in a clip or Reel is part of what Nora knows about it.
Audio files are described too, including a transcript of what is said, in the language it is spoken in.
Video and audio are read by MiMo v2.6 Flash through OpenCode Go directly, at far lower token cost and far more request headroom than the previous video model.
limitations: Media Nora already read keeps its earlier, silent description; only media read from now on is heard.
The describer is asked to leave out phone, ID and account numbers it hears, but that is a request to the model, not a filter: a spoken number can still appear in a description.
A clip's windows are still read one after another, not in parallel.
